historical-playground.execution: All binaries compiled first using CPUs 0-31; then four simultaneous games, each on three physical cores plus SMT siblings, without any experiment compilation.
historical-playground.accounting: os.wait4: user+system process CPU seconds, peak RSS KiB; wall clock includes startup and shutdown
historical-playground.observer: Legacy random-games driver: 8 AI controllers plus one idle local observer
historical-playground.qualification: 14x32 natural-winner games with one-hour cap, all winners observed. Historical rules/random streams/AI/replay defaults differ; trajectory changes prevent causal attribution from E2E alone. Earlier binaries can be serial despite six-CPU mask; CPU allocation is not proof of six compute participants. Frozen historical tip is not current master.

historical-oazis.execution: All binaries compiled first using CPUs 0-31; then four simultaneous games, each on three physical cores plus SMT siblings, without any experiment compilation.
historical-oazis.accounting: os.wait4: user+system process CPU seconds, peak RSS KiB; wall clock includes startup and shutdown
historical-oazis.observer: Legacy random-games driver:11 Nicowar controllers plus one idle local observer
historical-oazis.qualification: Campaign held and incomplete: six revisions observed, eight unobserved. Existing progress/report state can say running, but hold prevents dispatch; no completion of remaining 256 claimed. Timeout CPU/wall remain consumption measurements, not completed-game E2E; missing ticks/TPS remain unknown. Same legacy runner has 11 AIs plus idle local observer; distinct from exact eleven-controller later fixtures.

thread-scaling.scope: Final9e only, six vs24logicalCPUbudgets; GPUoff/GPUon separate; requested1/3/6/12/auto, auto6/24. Every ratio pairs same seed/block withN1. No production optimum selection or transfer to othermachines. 2seeds×3blocks are descriptive; no unmatched workload pooling.

mature-perf.qualification: One continuously evolved late Oazis window near120064-128000; CPU task-clock sample ranking, not whole-game CPU fractions or prediction of speed savings. 56.8662% empty callchains: full caller/all-active-thread coverage unproven. Original substring category table in analysis-v4/analysis.json is explicitly superseded by leading-namespace-supplement-v1.json: snapshot handle type appearing in a gradient template does not make gradient work snapshot work. Exact binary text/outcome/replay proof is separate from loaded512tick checksum continuity; continuous every-tick late-window equivalence not claimed.

excluded: Detailed simulation/world checksums and full replays/saves
perf.data, structured samples and raw record/callchain exports
Full build stdout logs and generated plot duplicates
Unexecuted Oazis revisions, unexecuted profile policy calibration
limits: Compact evidence preserves per-run scalar inputs, tested workload identities, provenance and scoped conclusions; not a bit-for-bit complete reproduction of all raw diagnostics. Original scripts with absolute paths are historical records; use bundled standalone reanalysis for compact CSVs.
